topics.label: Lecture Introduction
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture and contextualises complement within the immunology curriculum.

topics.label: Fundamentals and Core Principles of Complement
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics introduce the general architecture, nomenclature conventions, and central role of C3 in the complement system.

topics.label: Complement Activation Pathways
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the three recognition pathways that trigger complement activation and converge on C3 convertase formation.

topics.label: Complement Effector Mechanisms
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the downstream effector functions activated by complement to target and eliminate pathogens.

topics.label: Host Regulation of Complement
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains the regulatory proteins and mechanisms that protect host cells from accidental complement-mediated destruction.

topics.label: Clinical Consequences of Complement Deficiencies
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic examines the diverse clinical conditions and symptoms associated with deficiencies in specific complement components.

topics.label: Pathogen Evasion of Complement
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details the mechanisms evolved by pathogens to evade complement destruction, focusing on Staphylococcus aureus.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic delivers the closing remarks and indicates the upcoming lecture topic.
